About

Welcome to Badger Labs!

I’m Rayjan Wilson, a software engineer and lifelong learner. This blog is my space to document things I figure out—whether it’s solving tricky software engineering problems, exploring Linux, or experimenting with new tools and technologies.

You’ll find guides, troubleshooting notes, and insights from my day-to-day work and tinkering. My goal is to share practical knowledge that might help others (and my future self) along the way.
